problem: There is no 4대보험 계산기 that shows both the employee and employer shares. People search for this a lot (employers, HR staff and freelancers starting a first job), and the site already has tested 2026 rates for it. Right now the rates only appear as deduction lines inside the salary result.
evidence: tools.ts:30-56 registers 25 tools and none of them is a 4대보험/사업주 부담 tool. The only mention is the `aliases: [... "4대보험" ...]` entry on salary (line 31). src/lib/rates/insurance.ts:2 says "2026 근로자 4대보험 (employee share)", and `employeeInsurance()` (line 52) is already tested against the 4insure simulator, per the header comment at line 14. docs/research/insurance-2026.md:57 already records 산재 "Average 1.47%, paid entirely by the employer", and :9 records "4.75% employer 부담금".
fix:
Add a new tool "four-insurance" following the files listed in `docs/CONVENTIONS.md`:
- `src/lib/calc/four-insurance.ts` and its test file
- `src/app/four-insurance/page.tsx`
- a FourInsuranceCalculator component

`src/lib/tools.ts` is a shared file under CONVENTIONS line 32, so the orchestrator registers the tool there. Suggested entry: category "work", aliases such as 4대보험 요율, 사업주 부담, 인건비, 산재보험.

**Calculation**
1. Employee column: reuse `employeeInsurance(pay, payMonth, opts)`.
2. Employer 국민연금, 건강보험 and 장기요양 are the same amounts as the employee's. This also holds for the November 2026 장기요양 switch to 0.1314.
3. Employer 고용보험: compute as one truncation, `floor((pay*(90+X))/10000)*10`, with X = 25, 45, 65 or 85 by company size (`insurance-2026.md:103`). Test it against the 4insure vector: 3,000,000 at <150인 gives 34,500.
4. If the employee is exempt from 실업급여 (hired at 65 or older), the employer still pays the X part. Do not zero the whole employer 고용보험.
5. 산재: an editable rate defaulting to 1.47%, the 2026 average (고용노동부 고시, unchanged for a second year, includes the 출퇴근재해 0.06%). Label it clearly as an average that differs by industry.

**Output**
- Show the employee total, the employer total, and the total labor cost (월급 + 사업주 부담).
- Add a 2026 요율표 section.

**두루누리 (optional)**
- It covers only 국민연금 and 고용보험, not 건강보험 or 산재.
- It pays 80% of both the employer and employee shares, for new enrollees at workplaces with fewer than 10 workers.
- The commonly cited 2026 pay threshold is 월평균보수 270만원 미만, but only secondary sources give it. Verify it at comwel.or.kr before coding it.

problem: There is no standalone 3.3% calculator for 프리랜서/알바 세금, covering 세전↔세후 역산 and 8.8% 기타소득. This is a very common, simple and verifiable query, and the site already has tested logic for it, but it only exists inside the hourly-wage result.
evidence: hourly-wage.ts:169 `export function freelanceTax(gross)` already applies 소득세 3% and 지방세 10% with 10원 절사. Add a new tool /freelance-tax/ (e.g. "3.3% 계산기 - 프리랜서 세금·실수령액") with these parts:
- Logic: move freelanceTax out of src/lib/calc/hourly-wage.ts into src/lib/calc/freelance-tax.ts or a shared rates module, and re-export it from hourly-wage so its existing tests keep passing.
- gross→net.

Pipeline:
1. 총급여 → 근로소득공제 (§47, 2천만 한도) → 근로소득금액.
2. Subtract 소득공제: 인적공제 150만/인 (§50), 연금보험료 (국민연금 × 12), 건강·고용보험료 (특별소득공제, from `employeeInsurance`).
3. Include 신용카드 등 소득공제 as a simple input. This is not optional because nearly every user has it. Inputs: 신용/체크·현금/전통시장·대중교통 amounts. Rules: 최저사용금액 25% of 총급여, rates 15/30/40%, 기본한도 300만 (총급여 7천만 이하) or 250만, plus the 추가한도. Verify each figure against 조특법 §126의2 on law.go.kr.
4. 과세표준 → `basicIncomeTax()` from severance.ts. Consider moving it to a shared rates file instead of importing it from severance.
5. Subtract 세액공제:
   - 근로소득세액공제 (§59): 55% up to 130만, then 71.5만 + 30%. 한도 74만 / 66만 / 50만 / 20만 by 총급여.
   - 자녀세액공제 (§59의2, 2025.1.1 시행, still in force for 2026): 25만 / 55만 / +40만 per child. Also 출산·입양 30/50/70만.
   - 혼인세액공제 50만 (2024~2026 혼인신고).
   - Either the 표준세액공제 13만 (only if no 특별소득·특별세액공제 or 월세 is claimed) or entered 월세, 연금저축/IRP, 의료비, 교육비, 보험료 credits.
6. 결정세액 + 지방소득세 10%.

For 기납부세액, let the user type it in from the 급여명세서 or 원천징수영수증. Offer a computed default only as a fallback: Jan–Feb with `payMonth` "2026-01"/"2026-02" and Mar–Dec with "2026-03", applying the chosen 80/100/120 ratio. Do not use October × 12.

Show 환급 or 추가납부, and note that the 2026-08-03 세제개편안 (부양가족 소득요건 300만, 출산·혼인 세액공제 폐지, 월세 확대) is pending in the National Assembly and mostly applies from 2027. Re-check after the December 의결.

Golden tests should come from the NTS 2026 귀속 연말정산 신고안내 worked examples.

Also update the 12~1월 row in docs/PROMOTION.md. Drop the unsupported "biggest seasonal query" claim. 종합소득세 and 근로장려금 stay next for May; note that the 근로장려금 expansion applies from 2027 과세기간.

3) Where acquisition-tax prose first mentions 전용 85㎡ (page.tsx:96), link the text to /pyeong/85/ (it exists in PYEONG_PAGE_M2): "전용 85㎡(약 25.7평)".

problem: Four programmatic routes break the CONVENTIONS rule that programmatic H1s put the direct answer in the heading. Their titles also lack the number that sibling routes show (salary, age, acquisition-tax, car-tax, pyeong). Because the prose is otherwise templated, the H1 and title are the cheapest way to make each page distinct.
evidence: loan/[amount] line 113: h1 `${label} 대출 이자: 월 상환액 표 (금리·기간별)`; line 64: title `${label} 대출 이자 - 월 상환액 표 (금리·기간별)`. deposit/[amount] line 139: h1 `${label} 예금 이자: 1년 만기 금리별 세후 이자`; line 52: title without a number. savings/[monthly] line 99: h1 `월 ${m}만원 적금 1년 이자: 금리별 만기 수령액`; line 48: title without a number. bmi/[height] line 126: h1 `키 ${h}cm 표준체중과 정상 체중 범위`; line 67: title without a number. The BMI pages' three prose paragraphs (lines 141-148) are also identical across all 61 heights apart from the numbers.
fix: Put the headline number in both the H1 and the title, using values already computed on each page. Examples: "1억 대출 이자: 연 4% 30년 월 {base.payment}", "1억 예금 이자: 연 3% 1년 세후 {r.netInterest}", "월 50만원 적금 1년 이자: 연 3.5% 세후 {head.afterTaxInterest}원", "키 170cm 표준체중: 남 63.6kg·여 60.7kg (정상 53.5~66.4kg)". Keep titles at 45 characters or fewer.

problem: The /savings/<m>/ pages scale linearly. Their ratio sentences print the same percentages on all 6 pages, so only the won amounts change. Matching compound-interest scenario pages exist but are not cross-linked from either savings or deposit pages.

problem: Several high-traffic main-page leads describe the UI instead of answering the query, which the CONVENTIONS lead rule requires. The pyeong main description also has no concrete number, against the description rule.
evidence: pyeong/page.tsx:12 description: "제곱미터(㎡)를 평으로, 평을 ㎡로 바로 변환합니다. 아파트 전용면적 59㎡, 84㎡가 몇 평형인지 ... 확인하세요." problem: relatedTools() never links to car-tax or bmi from any page's "같이 쓰는 계산기" block. Together with their programmatic pages, that is 73 URLs that get only footer and home-page links and no contextual ones. The cause is that car-tax is 8th of 8 in the money category, and the block is cut at 6.
evidence: tools.ts:69-74: `[...same, ...others].slice(0, count)` with count 6. Simulating relatedTools for all 25 slugs gives inbound counts car-tax 0 and bmi 0, while salary and age get 16 each. Every money tool has 7 same-category siblings, so the 7th (car-tax, last in TOOLS order) is always dropped.
fix: This is a shared-file change, so report it to the orchestrator. Add an optional `related?: string[]` to Tool, with curated pairs: loan↔acquisition-tax/brokerage-fee/rent-conversion, car-tax↔loan/vat, bmi↔due-date/age, salary↔severance/unemployment. relatedTools() should use the curated list first, then same-category, then popular. Alternatively, rotate same-category picks so that every tool appears in at least 2 blocks.

problem: Enlistment-month pages for 2024-06 to 2024-12 now describe service that has fully ended for every branch, but they still use future tense and stay indexed. The dday event pages handle the same situation with past-tense copy and noindex.
evidence: src/lib/calc/discharge.ts:216 sets PAGE_FIRST_MONTH = { y: 2024, m: 6 }. With 21 months for 공군, a 2024-12 enlistment ends by 2026-09-29, before 2026-10-09. Line 106 lead: "${y}년 ${m}월에 입대하면 ... 전역합니다". generateMetadata (lines 53-58) never sets noindex. Compare dday/[event]/page.tsx:60-61: `noindex: past`.
fix: Choose one approach. Either compute the latest discharge date (공군, last day of the month) against RULES_CHECKED_AT and, when it has passed, switch to past tense ("전역했습니다") and pass `noindex: true` as dday does, or start the page list at the first month that still has soldiers in service. Keep 2027 months only if 입영 일정 demand exists.

problem: The date inputs have no lower year limit, so a half-typed year (Chrome passes "0002-…", "0020-…", "0202-…" while you type a year) is calculated as a real date. The result shows a 퇴직금 for a tenure of thousands of years.
evidence: Line 60: `const hire = parseYMD(s.s);` and parseYMD (src/lib/date.ts:18) accepts any 4-digit year. Line 105: `<DateField label="입사일" value={s.s} …/>` has no min/max, and nothing between lines 69-84 checks the year. src/lib/calc/dday.ts:136-137 says the native date input sends "0002-…", "0020-…", "0202-…" while a year is typed. Age (MIN_YEAR, AgeCalculator.tsx:19,29), due-date (isUsable, :74-76), dday (parseInputDate) and subscription-score (checkDateInputs MIN_YEAR) all guard against this; severance does not. Example: 입사일 0202-03-02 with the default 퇴직일 and 월 300만원 gives termDays of about 666,000 and an estimated hero of about 53억원 (not run), with 근속연수 of about 1,825년 in the tax rows. A user who stops at "202" keeps that result.
fix: Reject years below 1900 (or 1000) for both 입사일 and 퇴직일 and show a CalcNotice such as "입사일은 1900년 이후 날짜로 넣어 주세요.". Also pass min="1900-01-01" max="2100-12-31" to both DateFields, the same as AgeCalculator.

problem: The same half-typed-year problem: a partial year in 입사일 is calculated as a real date and gives a nonsense statement.
evidence: Line 68: `const hire = parseYMD(s.h);`, then lines 70-73 call calculateLeave directly. The DateField at lines 87-92 has no min/max and there is no year check. 입사일 "0202-03-04" (an intermediate Chrome value while typing 2024) gives "근속 1,82x년 연차" 25일 and "입사일 202년 3월 4일". calculateLeave also loops once per anniversary (annual-leave.ts:167), so it runs about 1,800 iterations.
fix: Treat hire or asOf with y < 1900 as invalid and show a CalcNotice. Add min="1900-01-01" max="2100-12-31" to both DateFields.

problem: The hero figure cannot wrap and sits next to a fixed-width seal. On a 360px phone, amounts of about 10 digits or more (10억원 and up) run under the red seal, and the largest amounts overflow the statement and make the page scroll sideways. Compound interest is the main trigger: it allows balances up to 1,000조원 and shows a stamp.
evidence: globals.css:351 `font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 9cqi, 2.625rem)` and :357-358 `word-break: keep-all; overflow-wrap: normal;`. The .seal at :365-370 is `flex: none; width: 4.25rem`, and .statement-hero has gap 1rem and padding 1.25rem. My width estimates, not measured in a browser: at 360px the statement is 326px wide, so the font is about 29.3px and the value column is about 326−40−68−16 = 202px. An 11-digit amount such as 1억 at 10% for 50 years (≈145억, "14,5xx,xxx,xxx원") is about 7.7–8em, roughly 225–235px, which overlaps the seal. CompoundInterestCalculator.tsx:191 `value={formatWon(res.balance)}` with stamp="복리" allows up to MAX_BALANCE 1e15 (compound-interest.ts:247). A 16-digit value is about 320px, which goes past the statement border, and nothing on body or the parents clips overflow-x.
fix: In the shared CSS, either let .statement-hero wrap (flex-wrap: wrap) so the seal drops below a long value, or scale the font down by character count. In compound-interest you can also use koreanWon (억/조) for the hero once the balance is 10억 or more and keep the exact won amount in a row.

problem: The header search box on every page uses a 15px font. iOS Safari auto-zooms the page when a field under 16px gets focus, so iPhone users get a zoomed page every time they tap search.
evidence: Line 48: `className="h-9 w-full rounded-lg … text-[0.9375rem] …"` (15px). layout.tsx:49-54 viewport sets no maximumScale (it shouldn't). All calculator inputs are 16px or larger (.field-input 1.125rem, .field-select and the date input 1rem), so this is the only field that triggers the zoom.
fix: Use 16px on small screens, e.g. `text-base sm:text-[0.9375rem]`.

problem: 변화율 mode accepts negative A/B values (allowNegative), but the field always asks for the decimal keypad. The iOS decimal keypad has no minus key, so iPhone users cannot type a negative value; they can only paste one.
evidence: DecimalField.tsx:66 `inputMode={decimals > 0 ? "decimal" : "numeric"}` does not depend on `allowNegative`. PercentCalculator.tsx:259 and :269 pass `allowNegative` for 이전 값/이후 값, and the footnote at :342-343 has copy specifically for `a < 0` ("이전 값이 음수라 절댓값을 기준으로…"), so negative values are an intended input.
fix: When allowNegative is set, add a small "± 부호" button next to the box that flips the sign, or use inputMode="text" for those two fields.

problem: Every StepperField's −/+ buttons have the same accessible name ("하나 줄이기"/"하나 늘리기") with no field name. The button that reaches min/max is also `disabled` while it has focus, which drops keyboard focus to <body>.
evidence: Line 268 `aria-label="하나 줄이기" … disabled={value <= min}` and line 275 `aria-label="하나 늘리기" … disabled={value >= max}`. SalaryCalculator.tsx:168-189 renders two steppers (공제대상가족 수, 8~20세 자녀 수), so Tab announces two identical "하나 늘리기" buttons. Pressing + until max (e.g. 주 근무일수 7, 부양가족 6) disables the focused button.
fix: Give the label an id and set `aria-labelledby` on each button (or build the aria-label from the field label). Use `aria-disabled` and ignore clicks instead of `disabled`, so focus stays on the button.

problem: The whole statement body is a polite live region, so for screen-reader users every keystroke in a number box queues announcements of every changed row, footnote and total (often 10–20 values).
evidence: Line 33: `<div className="statement-body" aria-live="polite">` wraps the hero, all StatementSection rows and the footnotes. Every calculator re-renders the full statement on each keystroke; for example the salary statement has about 13 rows plus the total and footnote. CalcNotice already provides role="status" for the empty or invalid state.
fix: Remove aria-live from .statement-body. Announce only the headline: a visually hidden role="status" with the hero label and value, or aria-live plus aria-atomic on .statement-hero.

problem: Field hints are not linked to their controls, so screen readers do not read essential instructions and warnings when a field gets focus.
evidence:
fields.tsx:33 (FieldFrame), :176 (SegmentedField) and :301 (CheckboxField) render `

{hint}

` with no id, and no input, select, radiogroup or checkbox has aria-describedby. The same markup is copied into loan/DecimalField.tsx:102, percent/DecimalField.tsx:99, salary/DecimalField.tsx, brokerage-fee/DraftNumberField.tsx and hourly-wage/HoursField.tsx:81. Critical guidance lives only in hints, e.g. SeveranceCalculator.tsx:110-115 (퇴직일 = 마지막 근무일의 다음 날) and the hourly-wage below-minimum-wage warning passed as `hint`.
fix:
Generate a hintId with useId, put it on the hint

, and add aria-describedby={hint ? hintId : undefined} to the control (to the radiogroup for SegmentedField). Mirror this in the five local copies.

problem: Each /hourly-wage/<hours>/ page shows two different after-deduction (4대보험 공제 후) amounts for the same wage of 10,700원 and the same weekly hours. YearCompareTable computes its 2027 column with rateYear 2027, which uses 국민연금 5.0%. WageTable's 10,700원 row calls payForWeeklyHours(hours, w) with the default rateYear 2026, which uses 4.75%. The calculator's "2027 최저 10,700" preset also uses 2026 rates (calcHourly → insuredDeductions without a rateYear) and labels the row "4.75%".
evidence: tables.tsx YearCompareTable: `const b = payForWeeklyHours(hours, MIN_WAGE_2027, 2027);` vs tables.tsx WageTable: `const p = payForWeeklyHours(hours, w);` over WAGE_TABLE = [10_320, 10_700, ...]. hourly-wage.ts: `export function payForWeeklyHours(weeklyHours, wage, rateYear: RateYear = 2026)`. [hours]/page.tsx renders both <YearCompareTable hours={h} /> and <WageTable hours={h} />. For 주 40시간 the gross is 2,236,300 and the pension base is 2,236,000, so 국민연금 is 106,210원 at 4.75% and 111,800원 at 5.0%. Health (80,390), 장기요양 (10,560), 고용 (20,120) and tax are the same in both, so the two after-deduction figures on /hourly-wage/40/ differ by 5,590원.
fix:
Make WageTable follow one stated rate year and label it.
- Option A (smallest change): rename the column in `tables.tsx:143` to "4대보험 공제 후 (2026년 요율)". Add a sentence after the WageTable intro in `[hours]/page.tsx:202-204`: the 10,700원 row uses 2026 요율, and the 2027 figure with 국민연금 5.0% is in the 2026·2027 table above.
- Option B: in WageTable, call `payForWeeklyHours(hours, w, w === MIN_WAGE_2027 ? 2027 : 2026)` and mark that row "2027 요율". Then the 10,700 row matches the YearCompare 2027 column. Doing this also makes the `hourlyBasis()` line wrong, so rewrite it to something like "4대보험 2026년 요율 (2027년 열은 국민연금 5.0%)".

For the calculator (another agent is editing it now), when `s.w === MIN_WAGE_2027` and mode is "insured", add a hint saying the deductions use 2026 요율 and the 2027 국민연금 is 5.0%. Optionally pass rateYear 2027 through `calcHourly` → `insuredDeductions` and change the pension note from the hard-coded "4.75%" to match.

problem: Three tools describe the status of 2027 4대보험 rates differently and handle 2027 take-home pay differently. minimum-wage refuses to show 2027 take-home pay because the rates are "not yet set". hourly-wage shows 2027 take-home pay with legislated pension at 5.0% and assumes 2026 values for the rest, and calls the health rate unconfirmed. salary says the 2027 health rate was announced as frozen at 7.19%.
evidence: MinimumWageCalculator.tsx: "2027년 4대보험 요율은 아직 확정 전이라 세후 금액은 빼고 보여 드려요." | hourly-wage/[hours]/page.tsx: "2027년 열은 법으로 정해진 국민연금 인상(근로자 4.75% → 5.0%)만 반영하고, 아직 확정되지 않은 건강·장기요양·고용보험 요율과 간이세액표는 2026년과 같다고 가정했습니다." | salary/page.tsx FAQ: "2027년 건강보험료율은 7.19%로 동결한다고 발표됐고, 고용보험료율 인상안은 2026년 10월 현재 확정되지 않았습니다." docs/research/insurance-2026.md lists health_insurance_rate_2027 = 7.19% (frozen, 건정심 2026-09-08, medium).
fix:
1. Fix the wrong statement first. In src/app/hourly-wage/[hours]/page.tsx:196, change the note to say the health rate is frozen at 7.19% (건정심 2026-09-08 의결), and that only the 장기요양·고용보험 rates and the 간이세액표 are assumed at 2026 values. Example: "2027년 열은 법으로 정해진 국민연금 인상(근로자 4.75% → 5.0%)과 7.19%로 동결된 건강보험료율을 반영하고, 아직 정해지지 않은 장기요양·고용보험 요율과 간이세액표는 2026년과 같다고 가정했습니다." Update the comment in src/lib/calc/hourly-wage.ts:23-25 the same way.

2. Make minimum-wage consistent with it. The simplest option is to reword MinimumWageCalculator.tsx:194 (and the comment at src/lib/calc/minimum-wage.ts:202), e.g. "2027년 장기요양·고용보험 요율과 간이세액표가 아직 정해지지 않아 세후 금액은 빼고 보여 드려요". The better option is to show a labelled 2027 estimate with the same rules as hourly-wage's `insuredDeductions(…, 2027)`, so both tools give the same number for the same case.

3. Optional: put the 2027 status in one shared place, such as a comment or constant in src/lib/rates/insurance.ts (pension 5.0% legislated; health 7.19% frozen per 건정심 2026-09-08, 고시 not checked; 장기요양 and 고용 1.0% proposal undecided as of 2026-10-09). Salary FAQ line 83 already matches this and needs no change.

problem: acquisition-tax says homes up to 전용 85㎡ are exempt from 농어촌특별세, with no exception. pyeong correctly qualifies 국민주택규모 as 85㎡ only "수도권·도시지역 기준". Don't change the calculation. Make the toggle mean 국민주택규모 instead of a flat 85㎡:

(2) page.tsx:96 and :244-245: change the wording to "전용 85㎡(수도권 밖 도시지역이 아닌 읍·면은 100㎡) 이하 주택에는 농어촌특별세가 붙지 않습니다."
(3) acquisition-tax.ts:17: change the comment to "서민주택(주택법 제2조제6호 국민주택규모: 전용 85㎡, 수도권 외 비도시 읍·면 100㎡ 이하, 시행령 제4조⑤)은 비과세."

problem: The salary calculator applies the 4대보험 rules for the current month (rulePayMonth(today)) and its page says so. hourly-wage and minimum-wage always use the October 2026 rules. From November 2026 the salary calculator switches 장기요양 to 건강보험료 × 0.1314, but the other two keep the exact 0.9448/7.19 ratio. The same monthly taxable pay will then show a 장기요양 amount 10원 different between tools.
evidence: hourly-wage.ts: `export const HOURLY_PAY_MONTH = "2026-10";` (RATE_PAY_MONTH 2026). minimum-wage.ts netMonthly2026: `employeeInsurance(monthly, DEFAULT_PAY_MONTH)` with salary.ts `DEFAULT_PAY_MONTH = "2026-10"`. SalaryCalculator.tsx: `const payMonth = rulePayMonth(today.y, today.m);`. salary/page.tsx: "계산기는 접속한 달의 규칙을 자동으로 적용합니다." Example: monthly taxable 2,345,678 gives health 84,320, so 장기요양 is 11,080 (exact ratio, hourly-wage) vs 11,070 (0.1314, salary from 2026-11). This matches the vector in docs/research/insurance-2026.md.
fix:
Make the client calculators follow the visitor's current month, as salary already does, and let each static page name its own fixed month.

1. `HourlyWageCalculator.tsx`:
   - Get `today` from `useToday()`.
   - Pass `payMonth: rulePayMonth(today.y, today.m)` into `calcHourly` at line 50.
   - Replace the fixed footnote text "2026년 10월 요율" at line 220 with `${payMonthLabel(payMonth)} 요율`.
2. `minimum-wage.ts`:
   - Give `netMonthly2026` an optional `payMonth = DEFAULT_PAY_MONTH` parameter.
   - Pass it to both `employeeInsurance` and `monthlyWithholding`.
3. `MinimumWageCalculator.tsx`:
   - Call `netMonthly2026(r.monthly, rulePayMonth(today.y, today.m))`.
   - Name that month in the "세후 금액은 … 요율" footnote.
4. Leave the static pages (`hourly-wage/[hours]/page.tsx`, `minimum-wage/page.tsx` net26) on `DEFAULT_PAY_MONTH`, and add "2026년 10월분 기준" to their prose. Optionally add the November figure where it differs, as `salary/[amount]/page.tsx` does with `r11`.

Do this after the other agent's exact-hours edit lands in those two directories. If the 0.1314 switch later proves wrong, remove it from `insurance.ts` instead. Either way, all three tools must give the same 장기요양 for the same pay and month.

problem: The privacy policy tells users to send inquiries to a contact listed on the 소개 page, but no contact exists anywhere on the site. The about page, the footer and src/lib/site.ts have no email, form or operator name. For a site full of YMYL pages (tax, pay, pregnancy), and one that plans to run AdSense according to privacy section 3, this is a broken promise and a trust gap.
evidence: src/app/privacy/page.tsx:34 "개인정보와 관련한 문의는 사이트 소개 페이지에 안내된 연락처로 보내 주세요." src/app/about/page.tsx has only four sections: intro, 계산 기준, 개인정보, 주의할 점. Grepping for 연락/문의/메일/@ in about/page.tsx, SiteFooter.tsx and lib/site.ts finds nothing.
fix: Add a real contact channel to the 소개 page and put it in a shared constant, for example SITE_CONTACT in src/lib/site.ts. Use an email address or the GitHub repository's issues URL, plus an operator name or handle. Show it in a new "문의" section in about/page.tsx and link it from SiteFooter. Privacy line 34 can then use the same constant directly instead of pointing readers to another page. If no contact channel will be published, reword line 34 so it does not promise one. Because about/page.tsx and site.ts are shared files, this goes through a shared-file change request.

problem: The privacy policy says the site does not store entered values. The char-count tool does store the user's full text in sessionStorage, and in localStorage when '창을 닫아도 보관' is on. The policy never mentions browser-side storage, so it contradicts the char-count page's own FAQ.
evidence: privacy/page.tsx:7 "계산에 입력한 값을 서버로 보내거나 저장하지 않습니다"; :19-20 "이 값을 서버로 전송하거나 저장하지 않습니다". char-count/CharCounter.tsx:29-39 uses window.sessionStorage / window.localStorage. char-count/page.tsx FAQ: "지금 탭에만 잠시 저장하고, ‘창을 닫아도 보관’을 켜면 이 기기 브라우저에 남습니다."
fix: Add one sentence to section 1 of the privacy policy, for example: "글자수 세기는 새로고침에 대비해 입력한 글을 이 브라우저(세션/로컬 저장소)에만 보관하며 서버로 보내지 않습니다."

problem: The DSR section stops at the October 2025 rules. It says 3단계 스트레스 DSR applies 기본 1.5% to 주택담보대출 in general. It leaves out that 지방(비수도권) 주담대 is still on the 2단계 basis (1.5% × 50% ≈ 0.75%p) through 2026-12-31, under the 은행연합회 '2026년 하반기 스트레스 DSR 운영방안' published 2026-06-30. It also gives no 기준일 for this regulatory snapshot, even though the page's basis says the rules were checked 2026-10-09.
evidence: loan/page.tsx:219-221 "2025년 7월 1일부터 3단계 스트레스 DSR이 시행되어 주택담보대출과 기타대출, 잔액 1억원을 넘는 신용대출에 스트레스 금리(기본 1.5%)를 더해 DSR을 계산합니다. 2025년 10월 16일부터는 수도권·규제지역 ... 3%로 올랐습니다." Nothing in the section is dated 2026.
fix: Add a sentence such as "지방 주택담보대출은 2026년 12월 31일까지 2단계 기준(스트레스 금리 1.5%의 50%)이 유지됩니다(은행연합회 2026년 하반기 운영방안)." Also add an "(2026년 10월 9일 기준)" stamp to the DSR paragraph, and link the 은행연합회 or 금융위 notice.

problem: The /compound-interest/monthly-10-30y-10/ scenario projects money put into 'S&P 500 지수 상품' at 연 10%, described as the index's long-run average. The figure has no citation. Neither the compound-interest main page nor the scenario pages carry the explicit 'not investment advice' disclaimer that stock-average uses. The main page only has a 원금 손실 caveat, and the scenario template has none.
evidence: compound-interest.ts:355 "월 10만원을 미국 S&P 500 지수 상품에 30년 동안 넣으면 ... 연 10%는 S&P 500의 장기 연평균 수익률(배당 재투자, 달러 기준, 물가 반영 전)로 흔히 인용되는 값" (rendered at compound-interest/[scenario]/page.tsx:162, no source link). Compare stock-average/page.tsx:190 "특정 종목의 매수나 매도를 권하는 투자 조언이 아닙니다". The only caveat in compound-interest/page.tsx is at :256-257, and it does not appear on scenario pages.
fix: Link a source for the 10% figure, for example S&P Dow Jones Indices or another long-run total-return dataset, with its period. Add the stock-average style note to both compound-interest/page.tsx and [scenario]/page.tsx: "이 계산은 일정 수익률을 가정한 예시이며 투자 권유가 아닙니다. 과거 수익률은 미래 수익을 보장하지 않습니다."

problem: The hourly-wage page lists the probation 90% conditions as requiring a 1년 이상 contract only. It drops the 기간을 정하지 않은 근로계약 (정규직) case. The sibling minimum-wage page includes that case, so the two pages contradict each other, and a reader on an open-ended contract may conclude the rule does not cover them.
evidence: hourly-wage/page.tsx:162 "근로계약 기간이 1년 이상일 것 (1년 미만 단기 알바는 수습이어도 감액 불가)". minimum-wage/page.tsx: "근로계약 기간을 1년 이상으로 정했거나, 기간을 정하지 않은 근로계약(정규직 등)일 것".
fix: Use the minimum-wage wording: "근로계약 기간을 1년 이상으로 정했거나 기간을 정하지 않은 계약일 것".

problem: Several pages break the CONVENTIONS rule of 합니다체 for long-form prose and 해요체 for UI microcopy. The pyeong page is the canonical reference that other agents copy, and its prose uses 해요체. Some leads, the UI microcopy, end in 합니다체 instead. Some meta descriptions switch register mid-text.
evidence: pyeong/page.tsx:57 prose "단지마다 1~2평 다를 수 있어요." age/page.tsx:79 lead "...바로 알려 드립니다." percent/page.tsx:83 lead "...계산해 드려요. ... 답을 보여 드립니다." minimum-wage/page.tsx:24 and vat/page.tsx:17 descriptions are 합니다체 but end in "...계산해요." app/page.tsx:39 "계산합니다. ... 공유할 수 있어요."
fix: Pyeong prose: "다를 수 있습니다." Age and percent leads: "알려 드려요" / "보여 드려요". Meta descriptions: use one register, for example "...도 계산합니다."
